cuentos.r: A whimsical garden where a carrot and melon's love faces prejudice and evil.
Princess Emma goes on a magical quest to find all the missing socks in her kingdom. To get them back, she must challenge the funny King of the Toes to an epic dance-off!
A little elephant discovers that flying doesn't always require wings, but something much more valuable.

cuentos.t: Leo and the Island of Lost Manners
cuentos.r: On a magical island, a boy named Leo discovers that kind words have a power greater than he ever imagined. He learns that being polite is just as important as being honest.
A former space marine and her faithful pet otter face incredible challenges on a faraway planet as they journey to find a way back home.

cuentos.t: Leo and the Magical Veggie Challenge
cuentos.r: A young boy discovers a magical place where vegetables teach him valuable lessons. Through fun challenges, he learns how eating healthy can make him faster, stronger, and more balanced.

cuentos.t: A Mammoth, an Adventure, and a New Friend for Grit and Grat
cuentos.r: Cave-girl twins Grit and Grat have an unexpected adventure in the forest. After getting lost, they bravely rescue a trapped mammoth, who becomes their new friend and helps them find their way back home.

cuentos.t: A Kingdom of Games: Boardlandia's Friendship Test
cuentos.r: In the kingdom of Boardlandia, a competition between two game leaders puts their friendship and loyalty to the test, teaching them that working together is their greatest strength.
A loyal dog named Buddy discovers that true love and happiness sometimes require making tough choices, leading him on a journey to find where he truly belongs.

cuentos.t: Rap and a New Family in Oakdale
cuentos.r: A group of friends transforms the life of an elderly woman in their neighborhood. Through music and kindness, they build a strong community bond and discover the power of empathy and teamwork.

cuentos.t: Emma and the Adventure of Whisper Lake
cuentos.r: Emma and Pipo embark on a new adventure to save Whisper Lake in the kingdom of Luminaris. When a mysterious, unbreakable ice covers the magical lake, it's up to them to find the one thing that can melt it and restore balance to the kingdom.

**Benny**, a very special teddy bear, discovers that his magical toots can be a lot of fun. With the help of his mom and a friendly doctor, Benny learns to embrace his unique ability and spread joy to his friends.
An unexpected adventure unites the inhabitants of the enchanted garden on a mission of bravery and friendship.

**Tiffany** and **Vincent** face challenges at school and learn about growing up and accepting changes. They learn that sometimes people act in ways that may seem harsh, but often have good intentions.
Fears aren't always real. Johnny learns to face his own invisible fears and discovers his inner strength.

cuentos.t: Tommy the Tooth Mouse Can't Sleep
cuentos.r: **Tommy the Tooth Mouse** can't fall asleep and seeks help to find a way to get some rest. He visits **Dr. Owl** who gives him helpful tips and tools to help him fall asleep. With the help of **Dr. Owl**, **Tommy** is able to get some much needed sleep!

cuentos.t: The Great Journey of the Panda Family
cuentos.r: A panda family in Japan struggles to protect their home from danger and embarks on an adventure. They learn about the importance of courage, empathy and love for nature. With the help of a Dream Dragon, they find a way to communicate with humans and save their forest home.
A dog and a cat forge a friendship while facing challenges and helping others together. This story highlights the power of kindness, empathy, and second chances.
A young boy named Owen learns a valuable lesson about love and letting go after discovering a beautiful rose he desperately wants to protect and make perfect.

cuentos.t: The Pufferfish Who Was Afraid to Puff Up
cuentos.r: **Glupi**, a timid pufferfish, faces his fear of puffing up with the help of his friends. He learns that facing your fears can be fun and that friends can help you overcome anything!

cuentos.t: The Summer Storm and the Secret of Petrichor
cuentos.r: One hot summer afternoon, **Lily** discovers the magical smell of rain with her father. He teaches her about the science and beauty of petrichor, creating a special moment together.

cuentos.t: Glupi, Tina, and the Magic Marble
cuentos.r: **Glupi** and **Tina**, two underwater friends, discover a special object on the seabed and learn a valuable lesson about friendship and sharing. A wise octopus helps them realize that the joy of companionship is more precious than any possession.
A fluffy little cloud floats through quiet places, enjoying how peaceful and pretty the world is.

cuentos.t: Glupi, Tina, and the First Day of School
cuentos.r: **Glupi**, **Tina**, and their friend **Lolo** are starting school! **Lolo** is going to a different school and feels lonely. With patience and the help of his friends, **Lolo** makes a new friend and learns that friendship can always bloom.

cuentos.t: Far Horizons 1: The Voyage to Veridia-7
cuentos.r: **Aura** and her mother embark on an intergalactic journey to a new home filled with challenges and mysteries. Leaving Earth behind, Aura must confront her fears and find strength in her new surroundings and relationships. This voyage will test their courage and resilience as they venture into the unknown.

cuentos.t: The Secret of the Golden Beach
cuentos.r: A peaceful story about two siblings who discover that the greatest treasure is the feeling of calm and wonder found in nature.

cuentos.t: The Search for the Magic Feather
cuentos.r: **Grit** and **Grat** embark on a new adventure: an exciting quest in the valley that will test their perseverance. They need to find a giant feather for their mother's cloak to protect their family during the harsh winter. With determination and teamwork, the twins might just succeed!
A little boy discovers what it means to have a baby sister and how to express his love for her. Tommy learns about sharing, caring, and the special bond between siblings.

cuentos.t: Lolo's Birthday at the Amusement Park
cuentos.r: A new adventure for Glupi and his friends, this time at the underwater amusement park. The story explores themes of friendship, empathy, and respecting others' feelings.

cuentos.t: Danny and the Mystery of Love
cuentos.r: Danny, a little detective, sets out to discover the mystery of love through sweet, everyday moments.

**Mike** grapples with his doubts after a storm and receives unexpected advice from a mysterious old man. This encounter leads him to reflect on his past mistakes and consider the possibility of a fresh start, filled with renewed purpose.

**Aura** faces difficulties in training and makes decisions that will have consequences. She learns that true strength lies not in physical enhancements, but in self-confidence and the support of friends. A story about overcoming adversity and finding your own path.
Glupi and his friends start a book club to make learning fun. Together, they turn a challenge into an exciting team adventure, reinforcing the power of friendship and teamwork.

**Leo** and **Nora**, two siblings with a special bond, find city life challenging and embark on a journey to a world of dreams. They learn the power of positive memories and mutual support to overcome their fears and anxieties.
A clumsy fairy godmother and her new charge must learn to work together to overcome the challenges of both the human and magical worlds.

cuentos.t: The Quest Under the Full Moon
cuentos.r: A young girl in a magical world learns to be true to herself and follow her heart. 🌟

cuentos.t: A Walk Through the Woods of Self-Love
cuentos.r: An encounter in the woods teaches Pipkin the rabbit a valuable lesson about self-acceptance and confidence, with the help of his wise friend, Finn.
A magical lighthouse guides lost stars back to the sky with the help of a brave little girl. Together, they remind the stars of their inner light and importance in the vast universe.

cuentos.t: The Reunion in the Crystal Caves
cuentos.r: **Glupi** and his friends have to say goodbye to **Estelito**, but they will soon meet again. They learn that true friendship can overcome distance.

cuentos.t: Leo Gets Lost in the Woods
cuentos.r: Leo and his special pet, Mr. Puffles, learn the importance of listening to grown-ups after a risky adventure in the woods.
**Aura** descends to a new planet and faces unexpected dangers during her first foray. She must learn to balance her courage with caution to survive the challenges of Veridia-7.

Join Little Red Riding Hood on a journey through the whispering woods! This gentle adaptation of the classic tale teaches children about safety and kindness, featuring a brave girl, a tricky wolf, and a happy ending that’s perfect for bedtime.
A vain emperor is tricked with an invisible suit of clothes that reveals the truth about everyone.

cuentos.t: Lily Learns to Care for Her Big Smile
cuentos.r: **Lily** discovers the importance of dental hygiene during her first visit to the dentist. Dr. Lila teaches her about keeping her teeth healthy.
Leo travels with his aunt on an old-fashioned train in this soothing, sensory story.
A calm story about connecting with the peaceful world of nature as the forest gently wakes up at sunrise.

Meet a tiny hero with a giant heart! When Little Chickpea gets swallowed by a hungry ox during a rainy adventure, he uses his wits (and a loud voice) to get home. A funny, heartwarming tale about bravery and family.
**Chelsea** is a special spoon who discovers new places and friends on her exciting journey. She learns that being different is what makes you special and that change can bring new adventures.
A different little duckling searches for his place in the world and learns a valuable lesson about acceptance.
Lily learns how important it is to help out at home, discovering the power of love and teamwork.
**Nora** and her dog **Lucky** embark on an adventure with some strange new friends. Together, they work to restore the balance of a forest in need.

A peaceful story about enjoying the warmth of home and the magic of shared moments. **Lily** cherishes her afternoons with her grandmother, **Rose**, learning about family history and the joy of simple activities like knitting.

Join Goldilocks on a whimsical adventure deep in the woods! This timeless classic about curiosity, respect, and finding what is “just right” is the perfect bedtime story to spark conversations about boundaries with your little ones.
An expedition turns into an unforgettable experience of survival and discovery.
An unexpected race teaches that effort and perseverance are the keys to achieving great things.
**Tommy** and his grandpa experience an exciting race filled with effort and fun. They learn about teamwork, perseverance, and the special bond between generations.
A bright star helps Liam feel safe in the dark. It makes bedtime a happy time!
Dive into the peaceful walk of Smokey, a sensory story about connecting with nature and the comfort of home.
A brave tin soldier experiences great adventures, facing challenges with courage and love.
Four youths, each with a unique elemental power, must overcome their differences and unite to restore balance to their world during a massive, unnatural storm.
An earthquake challenges Aura and her friends, bringing out the best in each of them.
Three little pigs build their houses while a big bad wolf plans to catch them.
A soothing bedtime story filled with tenderness, calm, and the warmth of family.
Alma the lamb learns a valuable lesson about the magic of sharing and the joy of playing together with her cousin, Lily.

Join two brave siblings on a magical journey through the woods. When they stumble upon a delicious house made of gingerbread and candy, they must use their wits to outsmart a tricky witch. A classic tale of teamwork, courage, and finding your way home.

A group of friends transforms a forgotten park into a clean, vibrant space full of life. Through teamwork and community involvement, they prove that even a neglected space can be revived with care and dedication.
Learn how to take a shower with a mischievous genie who turns bath time into a bubbly adventure. **Tommy** learns about hygiene and water conservation in a fun and engaging way.
A young spider discovers that asking for help can be the first step to learning and growing.

cuentos.t: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
cuentos.r: A timeless tale of wit and motherly love! When Mama Goat heads to the market, her seven little ones must band together to outsmart a tricky wolf. A perfect bedtime story about safety, bravery, and listening to your gut.
**Gus** learns to cope with the loss of his favorite toy with the help of magic and love. A heartwarming tale about finding comfort and moving forward.
A relaxing and evocative journey through the water cycle filled with sensations and calm. This story explores the different stages of a water drop's life, from a glacier to the ocean and back again.

cuentos.t: Distant Horizons 6: Veridita, the Connection to the New World
cuentos.r: On Veridia-7, the colonists deepen their connection with the planet while facing challenges and changes. The discovery of a unique mineral, Veridita, sets in motion a series of discoveries and decisions that could change life in the colony forever. Amidst explorations, unexpected bonds, and difficult farewells, **Aura** discovers that the planet holds secrets that deeply connect her to her surroundings and to others.

cuentos.t: Miss Millie and the Perfect Red Ribbon
cuentos.r: A timeless fable about looking beyond appearances. When Miss Millie buys a dazzling ribbon, she attracts many suitors, but only a clever trick saves her from a smooth-talking cat. A heartwarming tale of true friendship and inner beauty.
A clumsy but brave alien boy named Trix must find the missing Sun Egg to save his city from freezing. With the help of a rusty robot, he discovers that even a klutz can be a hero.

cuentos.t: The Star Who Forgot How to Shine
cuentos.r: A lost star finds inspiration in the simplest and most sincere gesture. It's a story about self-acceptance and the power of connection.
A sweet adventure full of color, friendship, and acceptance. Gus the elephant learns that being different is what makes him special, and helps his new friends embrace their unique qualities too.
The Miller family discovers that helping with chores makes life easier and even fun! By working together, they find more time for fun activities and create a more peaceful home.

cuentos.t: The Scrubby-Dubbies vs. The Grime Gang
cuentos.r: A little boy named Leo learns that washing his hands is a superpower. It helps tiny heroes, The Scrubby-Dubbies, protect him from the sneaky Grime Gang and their germy plans.

cuentos.t: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves
cuentos.r: A carpenter discovers a magic cave and learns the value of kindness and loyalty.
A relaxing story that awakens the senses in a shop full of aromas and textures. **Lily** discovers the magic hidden in the small details of everyday life.

cuentos.t: Raven and the Gift of Fire
cuentos.r: In a world frozen in eternal winter, a brave bird with snow-white feathers dares to challenge the gods. A captivating legend about courage, sacrifice, and the warm gift that changed humanity forever.

cuentos.t: Red, the Fox Who Found His Home
cuentos.r: An injured fox finds his place on an unexpected journey full of warmth and discovery. He learns about friendship, compassion, and finding where you truly belong. This heartwarming tale shows how even when things change, we can find happiness.

Discover the timeless tale of a wooden puppet who dreams of becoming a real boy. Packed with magic, humor, and heart, this story teaches children about honesty, bravery, and the unconditional love of family.
A tidy room holds a secret: the toys are on a mission to bring the magic of playtime back to their owner.
A young parrot apprentice pirate has fun adventures while learning to be part of the crew. He makes mistakes but learns valuable lessons about teamwork and perseverance.

cuentos.t: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
cuentos.r: Join Snow White on a magical adventure of friendship and courage! When a jealous Queen threatens her safety, a young princess finds a new family with seven tiny miners in the woods. A heartwarming tale for children about how true beauty comes from the kindness within our hearts.
A hostile planet, a corrosive storm, and decisions that will test their bonds.
A little dog with big dreams discovers the value of calmness and friendship. With the help of a gentle giant, he learns to share his dreams without disturbing others.

Discover the inspiring story of **Felipe**, a special deer at Aprisco Farm. After being rescued, his recovery teaches children the importance of protecting nature and respecting the freedom of wild animals.

cuentos.t: The Science of a Gentle Touch
cuentos.r: A scientist explores the magic of a gentle touch and its power to heal both body and soul.
A young shepherd boy learns a valuable lesson about the importance of always telling the truth.

cuentos.t: Patty the Flea from the Circus
cuentos.r: A magical story about courage, friendship, and a flea circus that never ceases to amaze. Patty the flea learns to overcome her insecurities with the help of her friends.

Four cousins discover a forbidden secret and embark on an adventure that will change their lives. They find old bikes in their grandfather's shed that take them on a journey to Ancient Egypt, where they learn about history and bravery.

cuentos.t: The Selkie’s Song: A Legend of the Sea
cuentos.r: A lonely fisherman discovers the magical secret of the Selkies. When he tries to keep a part of the magic for himself, he learns a powerful lesson: true love means setting someone free. A heartwarming Celtic legend.
A little seed embarks on an adventure filled with exciting discoveries. It learns that finding a home doesn't mean the end of exploration, but rather the beginning of a new chapter.

An unexpected friendship challenges prejudices and changes the classroom dynamic. Emily, a quiet observer, decides to befriend Carla, a classmate unfairly ostracized. Her simple act of kindness sparks a transformation, proving that small gestures can dismantle bullying and foster inclusion.
A fierce storm hits Aprisco Farm, sparking a race against time to rescue three little goat kids. One brave goat, Carola, leaps into action to bring them back to safety.
A young boy discovers a hidden world in the clouds after accepting a strange trade.
**Mikey**, a boy who gets angry easily, learns to control his emotions using simple techniques.

cuentos.t: The Star That Rocked on the Sea
cuentos.r: A gentle and luminous journey through the sky and sea, in a story that invites calm and sleep. It's a peaceful adventure for kids to enjoy right before bed.
An unexpected discovery leads **Lily** to uncover a world of magic and fantasy. She learns a valuable lesson about honesty and empathy when she finds magical slippers.
Experience the timeless magic of Cinderella! This classic tale of kindness, resilience, and a little fairy-tale magic is the perfect bedtime story to inspire your child's imagination and heart.
A magical clock teaches **Arthur** that true magic lies in doing good deeds. He learns valuable lessons about generosity and responsibility.

Whisk your child away on the ultimate bedtime adventure! Join Wendy, John, and Michael as they soar over London to a magical island where childhood never ends. A timeless tale of courage, friendship, and the magic of believing.

cuentos.t: Far Horizons 8: Shadows on the Moon
cuentos.r: Aura's journey to the moon of Veridia-7 becomes a revealing experience. During this trip, she reconnects with old friends, faces new emotions, and distances herself from the shadow that has been dimming her light, putting her survival skills to the test.
A young boy named Simon spends the summer in the countryside and discovers the relaxing magic of shaping pottery with his own two hands, finding a new sense of calm and creativity.

A touching story about the eternal love for a pet and saying goodbye, ideal for learning about grief. It gently explores the bond between a child and their beloved cat, focusing on cherished memories and finding peace in farewell.
A young boy is convinced that his math teacher is turning into a witch. He has plenty of evidence to back up his claim, or so he thinks.
A bunny discovers the power of words and how to use them to make others feel good. He learns about empathy and kindness through a pair of magical shoes.
A sensory and relaxing story about snow, perfect for reading to children before bed. It creates a calming atmosphere and encourages appreciation for nature's beauty.
A young milkmaid dreams big while walking to the market, but she will learn a valuable lesson.
An injured vulture, a difficult rescue, and an uncertain future. A story about nature and its protection.
A classic tale of cunning and fortune featuring a very clever feline.

cuentos.t: A New Visitor in the Garden
cuentos.r: A new visitor arrives in the enchanted garden, but not everyone welcomes him. Can they learn to live together?
A relaxing short story that awakens the senses through music and dance. Two dancers move in harmony with the music, expressing a deep connection.

**Aura** faces decisions that challenge her independence, her emotions, and her place in the colony. Tensions rise with **Isaac**, and she starts to see the toxic dynamics in their relationship. Meanwhile, the colony progresses in adapting to the planet, discovering new alloys to resist the corrosive sand.
Lily's magical drawings of dragons come to life, but when a special one escapes, she must use her creativity to find a way to bring it back home.

cuentos.t: Emma and the Mystery of the Talking Mirrors
cuentos.r: A mystery has taken over the castle, and Emma must face a world full of unpredictable reflections.
**Brian** challenges old beliefs to bring music back to his village. He learns that music from the heart can bring joy and harmony, even to a sleeping dragon.
A mischievous boy discovers that the experience of elders matters. He learns a valuable lesson about listening to advice after a magical adventure.

cuentos.t: The Mystery of the Dancing Bubbles
cuentos.r: A little Bubblie must overcome his anger to float happily again. This story teaches children about forgiveness and managing their emotions through friendship and joy.

cuentos.t: The Awakening of Bella the Butterfly
cuentos.r: The magical transformation of a small forest creature. **Bella** patiently experiences a beautiful metamorphosis, discovering a new world full of color when she finally leaves her cozy shelter.
A patient squirrel discovers the truth behind an owl's anger. Through acts of kindness, she learns the owl is struggling to care for her elderly mother.

**Wobbly Witch Wendy** tries a prank, but the magic becomes surprisingly delightful. A mix-up with glasses leads to unexpected, heartwarming results, turning mischievous intentions into joyful outcomes.
**Benny**, a buzzing bee, follows his musical dream, finding happiness in every note he plays. He learns that following your passion can bring joy to yourself and others.
A girl named Maya gets trapped in a mysterious maze created by her own shyness. There, she discovers that embracing her strengths and helping others is the only way to find her way out.

cuentos.t: Pedaling Through Time: Towards the Caravels
cuentos.r: A mysterious map leads the cousins on a new adventure in the past. When **Carlos** disappears, they must decide whether to rescue him, risking their own safety in the process.

On their first anniversary on Veridia-7, the colony celebrates amidst transformations and mysteries. New physical and emotional changes are emerging, deepening their connection to the planet, but a sudden threat reminds them of the secrets Veridia-7 still holds.
A journey into the heart of the forest and to a way of seeing that discovers the secret life hidden within stones.

cuentos.t: The Four Brave Ones of El Aprisco
cuentos.r: An unexpected visit transforms **María's** perspective on nature and animal care. She learns about the importance of helping wild animals while respecting their need to remain wild, even when it's hard to let them go.
An unusual day tests a family's calm, patience, and teamwork when a city-wide blackout changes everything.
In a magical world hidden among the roots of trees, an unlikely friendship between a magical creature and a human girl challenges fear to save a lost soul and an entire community.

A curious boy, a spark of inspiration... and everything starts to change. It shows how ideas don't just fall from the sky, but come from curiosity and connection. It teaches that everyone can inspire and that learning can come from unexpected places.

A calming and sensory bedtime story that invites children to follow a magical trail of moonlight paw prints. **Lily** the bunny discovers the joy of simple moments in nature. Perfect for winding down before sleep.

cuentos.t: Alex, the Hedgehog Who Didn't Want to Tidy Up
cuentos.r: Alex discovers that tidying up his room can also help him tidy up his life. He learns about responsibility and the importance of keeping his space clean for himself and his friends.

**Oscar**, a boy in a city where silence is forbidden, follows a cat to a forgotten room in an old hospital. There he discovers true silence with **Inari**, and together they create Silenia, a secret network of quiet spaces that awaken creativity and independent thought.

cuentos.t: Lucy and the Tournament of Nonsense
cuentos.r: A surreal tournament where the absurd becomes pure fun, teaching a young girl the joy of embracing the silly side of life.
A magical nighttime adventure among sheets, monsters, and a very brave captain. **Timmy** transforms his bed into a ship and sails the Slumber Ocean, facing the Nightmare Squid to protect his dreams.
In a moonlit clearing, memories and truth push Isaac to the edge.
A magical and gentle retelling of the classic fairy tale, perfect for drifting off to sleep. Discover a kingdom of dreams, a mysterious spell, and how hope—and a little courage—can wake up the world.
A stormy night turns into a peaceful adventure filled with imagination and questions under a cozy blanket.

cuentos.t: Alex and the Summer of Flavor
cuentos.r: Curiosity, respect, and new flavors: a story about supporting children who only eat "four things" without forcing them. When Alex spends the summer with his grandpa, he learns about new foods and flavors.
Rebellious stuffed animals and a magical routine make this a bedtime story full of giggles and cuddles, helping little ones drift off to sleep.
A small act of kindness sets off a chain of invisible, yet wonderful, events. Sometimes, even the smallest creatures can make a big difference.
An unexpected encounter that proves even the smallest among us can surprise you.

cuentos.t: Mysteries Under the Lens: Project Nessie
cuentos.r: A young researcher, **Nora**, explores Loch Ness in search of answers. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, she uncovers the truth behind the legend, revealing a fascinating natural phenomenon.
An empty summer, a sleeping city, and a pipe that shouldn't be there.

cuentos.t: A New Pup at the Park
cuentos.r: A different day at the park teaches that something new can be surprising... and enjoyable. It's a story about making friends and trying new things.
A classic fairy tale about a Prince searching for true royalty, a stormy night, and a tiny green pea that proves appearance isn't everything. A whimsical story about sensitivity and authenticity.

cuentos.t: Tilly the Turtle Learns to Fly
cuentos.r: A resourceful turtle named **Tilly** experiments with wacky inventions alongside her friends. Despite many comical failures, they never give up on the dream of flight, teaching children about perseverance and teamwork.

cuentos.t: I Don't Want to Go to School!
cuentos.r: A girl named Lily discovers that school might be more valuable than she ever imagined. After a magical wish comes true, she learns that a life without school is surprisingly boring and difficult.

**Aura** faces doubts, secrets, and a ritual with veridita that both connects and tears her apart. Caught between emotional pressure and a collective experience, she discovers her own limits and the need to protect herself.

An unexpected journey where routine is shattered, and a new way of belonging is born. **Lily**, a puzzle piece, finds herself lost and alone, but discovers value and belonging in the most unexpected places.
A journalist lands an interview with a long-lost scientist… and uncovers a truth far more disturbing than he ever imagined. A story for older teen readers.
A little monster discovers that baking cakes can be much more fun than scaring people.

cuentos.t: The Dance of the White Bag
cuentos.r: A white plastic bag dances with the autumnal breeze during a calm walk filled with beauty and gentle movement. It brings joy to those who witness its simple, yet captivating, performance in the park.
The colony mobilizes after the mysterious disappearance of Aura.
An old thimble hides a very peculiar genie who grants wishes… in his own way. **Ethan** finds this genie and quickly learns that his wishes may not be granted as requested!
A timeless tale about a girl with magical hair locked in a high tower, the brave prince who finds her, and the enduring power of love to heal even the deepest wounds.
On a very rainy day, puddles turn from something to avoid into the best part of the walk home for a little girl named Lily.

Join a master inventor and his daring son on a high-flying escape from ancient Crete. A timeless, tender tale about the thrill of freedom, the bond between father and son, and the vital importance of listening.
**Lily** discovers that even when her parents separate, love doesn't break.

In this timeless tale of redemption, a cold-hearted miser faces the terrifying ghosts of his Past, Present, and Future. A gripping story for families about the power of second chances and the true spirit of the holidays.

When a simple game turns into a high-flying jungle rescue, a boy and his father discover that the best adventures happen together. A heartwarming tale about imagination, bonding, and the magic hidden in everyday moments.

Meet Pebble, a little rock troll who is too round to sit still. While her family sleeps, she dreams of the ocean. A heartwarming bedtime story about curiosity, travel, and finding where you truly belong.

When King Sterling asks his daughters to measure their love, the youngest's answer—'like salt'—gets her banished. A heartwarming tale about realizing that true love is found in the essential, not the ornamental.

In this tender retelling of the classic fairy tale, a young mermaid named Seraphina dreams of a world above the waves. Perfect for bedtime, this story explores the power of love, sacrifice, and finding one's own soul.

When four farm animals are told they are too old to be useful, they team up to start a rockin' new life as musicians! A funny, heartwarming adventure about friendship, courage, and finding your own voice.

When screens start stealing the color from Leo's world, he discovers a digital nightmare where monsters consume reality. To save himself, he must team up with dream-strangers to protect their memories and rediscover the magic of the real world.

When a kindhearted girl helps a mysterious stranger at a spring, she receives a magical gift that transforms her words into treasures. A classic fairy tale about kindness, consequences, and the power of finding your voice.

cuentos.t: The Girl in the Mirror Hall
cuentos.r: In the towering Castle Dunhaven, a clumsy servant named Elara hides a magical secret. When a forbidden door opens, she discovers a destiny that will shake the kingdom and challenge a wicked Queen.
A sick man and a tortoise form a special friendship that will change both of their destinies.
Join Bamboo the panda on a whimsical milestone moment! When his diaper decides it wants to see the world, Bamboo finds the courage to try the potty. A sweet, encouraging tale for growing toddlers.

cuentos.t: The Royal Giant and the Scruffy Stray
cuentos.r: Rajah is a royal elephant who has everything—except a friend. When a starving stray dog sneaks into the palace, an unlikely bond forms. But when greed separates them, the kingdom learns that true friendship is the greatest treasure of all.
Meet a humble broom with a secret rock-star dream! This heartwarming bedtime story shows little ones that with a dash of imagination, you can be anything you want to be—even while doing your chores.

In an apartment building where the elevator always gets stuck, young Chloe discovers a magical secret behind the brick wall. A whimsical tale about friendship, critical thinking, and how even wizards sometimes overlook the simplest solutions.
When a young woman faces an impossible task, a mysterious little man offers magic help—but for a terrible price. A classic tale of riddles, gold, and the power of a name.

cuentos.t: The Mistake That Changed the World
cuentos.r: A snowy family road trip turns into an unexpected journey through history. When a question about the radio news comes up, a young boy learns how a scary invention and a newspaper's mix-up created the world's most famous prize.
Join Diodoro, a lovable but clumsy dodo, as he searches for his true calling. A heartwarming bedtime story about how validation, kindness, and encouragement are just as important as hard work.
A cat manages to make her dream come true... but not everything changes the way she expected.

A princess flees her kingdom to escape a terrible fate, hiding her royal identity beneath a humble disguise. With the help of her Fairy Godmother and three magical dresses, she discovers that true nobility shines through even the roughest appearance.

cuentos.t: Project Daedalus: The Deep Core Secret
cuentos.r: When NASA's top astronaut is assigned a mission to the bottom of the ocean instead of Mars, she expects disappointment. Instead, she and her crew discover a secret civilization hidden deep within the Earth's crust.

When the trail goes cold, a mother's intuition sparks a final, desperate search. But as technology fails and strange guardians appear, the team realizes that finding Aura is only the beginning of the mystery.

A classic tale about the power of kindness. When a runaway slave helps a wounded lion in the wild, he never expects that their friendship will one day save his life in the most dangerous place of all.
A mysterious musician saves a desperate town from a plague of rats, but when the greedy Mayor breaks his promise, the citizens pay a heartbreaking price. A classic tale about honor and consequences.

cuentos.t: Catalina and the Monster in the Closet
cuentos.r: A comforting bedtime story for parents and toddlers. Catalina learns a clever, sparkling trick to keep the closet monster away and sleep soundly all night long.
A brave boy born from a magical peach sets off on an exciting journey to save his village. A classic tale about courage, friendship, and doing the right thing.
A gentle story to help young children navigate grief. With tender words and a calm atmosphere, it supports little ones in processing the loss of a loved one.
Join Pelusa, a brave astronaut kitty, on a gentle journey to Mars! A heartwarming bedtime story about overcoming fear and making new friends in unexpected places, perfect for little dreamers.

cuentos.t: The North Wind and the Sun
cuentos.r: A classic fable about a contest between the North Wind and the Sun to see who is truly the strongest. A gentle story teaching children that kindness often works better than force.

cuentos.t: The Girl Who Refused to Look at the Ocean
cuentos.r: A cross-country move to the coast tests Maya, who is determined to hate her fresh start. But a disastrous surf lesson and a surprising friendship might just convince her to finally look up.
A freshly baked cookie springs to life and leads a merry chase, outrunning everyone who wants a bite—until he meets a clever fox. A classic tale of speed and wits.
A carefree grasshopper and a hardworking ant spend their summer in very different ways, creating a timeless story about the importance of planning ahead.
A touching fable about a special bowl that turns cloudy when lies are told. It teaches children that trust is fragile and must be rebuilt slowly, drop by drop, through honesty and patience.

A strikingly beautiful pheasant falls into the trap of perfectionism, freezing his life to maintain his image. A fable about the exhausting cost of external validation and the joy of reclaiming one's freedom.

When a mysterious and toxic object appears in the forest, a group of tiny heroes must brave the wild to restore balance. A heartwarming adventure about courage, unexpected allies, and the power of small actions.
When Lucille feels her very first loose tooth, she discovers the enchanting legend of the Tooth Fairy. A heartwarming classic about growing up, family bonding, and the magic of anticipation.

Can something remain the same even if everything about it changes? This lyrical retelling of a classic Greek paradox explores identity, memory, and growing up through the eyes of a curious boy in ancient Athens.

A weary traveler, a generous rabbit, and a Moon that learns the power of memory. A tender retelling of an Aztec myth about the true meaning of selflessness, perfect for sparking conversations about kindness and empathy.
A hungry Fox tries everything to reach a bunch of juicy grapes but just can't jump high enough. A timeless fable about how we handle frustration and the famous lesson of 'sour grapes.'
A soothing bedtime story about resilience and blooming where you are planted. This gentle tale helps children understand patience, grit, and the quiet power of hope.

A heartwarming bedtime story about a small, shy streetlight that feels insignificant compared to the big city lights, until it discovers that its gentle glow is exactly what a child needs. Perfect for teaching self-worth.

A mischievous little bunny named Peter disobeys his mother and sneaks into Mr. McGregor's garden. What starts as a delicious vegetable feast turns into a breathless escape in this beloved classic about curiosity and consequences.

cuentos.t: The Legend of Princess Kaguya: The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter
cuentos.r: A mysterious girl found inside a glowing bamboo stalk transforms the lives of an old couple. As she grows into a woman of unearthly beauty, a secret from the Moon threatens to separate them. A timeless classic about love, memory, and the beauty of fleeting moments.

cuentos.t: Protecting Pipo: Chased in the Rain
cuentos.r: A chance encounter with a frightened cat leads Charlie into a dangerous chase through a stormy neighborhood. What starts as a rescue mission turns into a mystery that proves courage—and unexpected friends—can be found in the most unlikely places.
A hungry traveler teaches a suspicious village that sharing a little can feed everyone. A timeless classic about community, generosity, and the magic of coming together.
An Emperor obsessed with perfection discovers a humble nightingale whose song reveals a breathtaking truth that no jewel could ever provide. A timeless tale of nature, freedom, and healing.
Nova wants nothing more than to join the secret neighborhood magic club, but her spells always go hilariously wrong. Will her chaotic magic end up saving the day?
Follow the famous Three Blind Mice in this classic nursery rhyme adapted into a short story! A cautionary tale that opens up important conversations with your little ones about acting on impulse.
When a school fundraiser goes slightly wrong, Inma learns that sometimes, trying to save face leaves a bitter taste. A tender story about peer pressure, guilt, and the courage to own our mistakes.

cuentos.t: The Most Disastrous Honeymoon in the World
cuentos.r: A modern witch and a giant monster set off to Paris for the perfect honeymoon, but soon discover that avoiding tourists and selfies is the real magic trick!
When a clever tailor swats seven flies with one blow, he stitches a belt to brag about his "heroic" deed, leading to giant-sized adventures!
A clever little lamb must use his wits—and his quick feet!—when a hungry wolf tries to trick him by a stream. A classic tale about standing up to bullies!

An exclusive sleepover, bitter black licorice, and the fear of not fitting in. A relatable, heartfelt story about peer pressure, finding your true friends, and the courage it takes to just be yourself.
A thirsty little cloud travels across the sky, sipping up mist until she's full... and a beautiful natural cycle begins. A soothing, rhythmic bedtime story about the water cycle and body awareness.
When a terrible famine strikes, a tiny boy uses his quick wits and immense courage to save his brothers from a fearsome ogre. A classic tale of brain over brawn!

cuentos.t: The Apprentice and the Furniture Rebellion
cuentos.r: When a talented but overconfident apprentice disobeys his master, he accidentally sparks a chaotic furniture rebellion! A magical tale about humility, taking responsibility, and the value of hard work.
Susi the squirrel is getting ready for winter! While her friends play, she gathers food. A gentle bedtime story about planning ahead, setting boundaries, and the true meaning of sharing.
A happy bee and a quirky fly debate their very different tastes in this hilarious, open-ended tale about perspective, respect, and finding your own favorite flavor in the world.

In the magical Land of Pegasi, a heavy little hippo and his rival must brave a fierce storm. A heartwarming bedtime tale about embracing our differences, true friendship, and finding your hidden strengths!

When a corrupt sheriff taxes the people into poverty, a brave young nobleman loses his lands and takes to Sherwood Forest. Join Robin Hood and his band of outlaws in this thrilling tale of justice, archery, and standing up for what is right!

cuentos.t: The Goose That Laid the Golden Eggs
cuentos.r: When a humble farmer discovers a goose that lays glittering golden eggs, his sudden fortune tests his patience. A classic tale about the true cost of greed and the magic of being thankful.
A proud bird learns a tough lesson when a clever trickster uses flattery to steal his snack. This classic fable is a perfect conversation starter about trusting others and the dangers of vanity!

cuentos.t: The City Mouse and the Country Mouse
cuentos.r: Two mouse cousins discover that a fancy feast isn't worth much if you can't eat it in peace. A classic tale of finding joy in the simple things!

cuentos.t: The Tooth Fairy Under the Sea
cuentos.r: When Glupi gets his very first loose tooth, he worries about growing up. But with a little help from his friends, he discovers that losing a tooth brings a magical underwater surprise!

cuentos.t: The Boy Who Set Out to Learn What Fear Was
cuentos.r: A fearless young boy travels the world to discover what it means to be scared. This classic Grimm tale celebrates curiosity, logical thinking, and the funny side of discovering our emotions! Perfect for 8+ readers.

cuentos.t: The Balloon That Flew So, So High
cuentos.r: When little Toby's brand-new balloon slips from his hand, his grandmother shares a magical secret. Discover the Land of Lost Balloons in this tender bedtime story about imagination, comfort, and letting go!
Discover the classic legend where brains beat brawn! A clever young shoemaker hatches a brilliant plan to save his city from a fearsome dragon. Perfect for inspiring creativity and problem-solving.

cuentos.t: The Dinosaur Who Didn't Want to Be Fierce
cuentos.r: Meet Max, a gentle little T-Rex! This tender bedtime story follows Max on a journey to find where he belongs. A beautiful tale about self-discovery, embracing what makes you unique, and family love.

cuentos.t: The Mystery of the Old Dinosaur Park
cuentos.r: When three friends sneak into their town's abandoned dinosaur park, they expect rusty robots—not breathing creatures. A thrilling mystery about courage that will keep kids guessing until the very end!

cuentos.t: The Old Man and His Grandson
cuentos.r: When a little boy builds a wooden bowl for his parents' future, they learn a powerful, heartwarming lesson about treating grandparents with love and respect.
A quick-witted cook gets herself into a hilarious pickle when her appetite gets the best of her. A classic tale of mischief, roasted chickens, and a very funny misunderstanding!
When a young princess drops her golden ball down a well, she makes a hasty promise to a helpful frog. A classic tale about keeping your word and finding magic in unexpected places!

Does your child swear they're trying their best, but the results say otherwise? When Fabian storms off to his room, his closet transforms into a wacky game show that measures his true effort! A funny, eye-opening tale about responsibility.
A majestic lion looks down on ordinary housecats, but his secret love for ear scratches and bouncy balls tells a very different story! A funny, gentle fable about pride and self-awareness.
In this classic fable, a smooth-talking scorpion asks a wary frog for a ride across a river. A powerful, thought-provoking tale about trust, logic, and the true nature of things.
A restless little corn kernel is tired of sitting still in his jar. He’s waiting for something big to happen—the Big POP! A delightful, sensory bedtime story about patience and big changes.
When the jungle animals host a grand ball, the clumsy flamingos go to dangerous lengths to find the perfect outfits, learning a tough lesson about envy and vanity.
When a mysterious foal is born at Ironwood Ranch, his owners soon discover he's no ordinary horse. A tender, magical tale about embracing what makes us unique and the quiet power of kindness.
A powerful, perfectly balanced island civilization thrives under the protection of the gods. But as ambition replaces harmony, the people of Atlantis must face the ultimate test.
Discover the secret history of horses! When human greed threatens majestic unicorns, a brave sorceress makes a heartbreaking choice to save them from extinction.
Barnaby the badger finds a frosty treasure, but soon learns that a shiny stone can't compare to the warmth and comfort of his best friend, Juniper the fox.
When little forest lantern Nino loses his glow trying to show off, he must discover what truly makes a light shine bright. A tender bedtime tale about kindness and finding your purpose!
Miles discovers the hard way that ignoring a messy room can lead to some seriously embarrassing consequences. A hilarious and relatable lesson in responsibility!
Ruth says "Yuck!" to all her food... until a very peculiar doctor gives her a magical checkup. A sweet story about picky eating, bravery, and becoming a flavor explorer!
Discover the classic tale of Humpty Dumpty, a proud egg who loved high places! A perfect bedtime story about the importance of listening, staying grounded, and looking before you leap.
A kind-hearted girl falls down a well into a magical winter world where her goodness is put to the test. A classic tale of hard work, magical rewards, and sticky consequences!
Marcelina the hen wants to look fancy, but her friends have some very silly ideas.

cuentos.t: The Heroes of Oak Creek Zoo
cuentos.r: When a glowing meteorite crashes into Oak Creek Zoo, three unlikely animal friends gain superpowers! Together, they must stop a wacky inventor in this action-packed yet cozy bedtime adventure.
A clever fox and a graceful stork invite each other to dinner and learn a timeless lesson about empathy, respect, and treating others exactly how you'd like to be treated!
In this classic Aesop's fable, a proud dog learns a gentle lesson about gratitude when he spots a 'rival' in the river. A perfect, quick bedtime story to help little ones appreciate what they have!
Saturday chores meet a wheezy old vacuum! When a giant dust bunny clogs his trusty sidekick, Miles must overcome his hesitation to fix it. A heartwarming tale of responsibility and care for ages 10+.

Hidden away lies a secret lake where misunderstood monsters aren't scary at all—they are gentle guardians! This soothing bedtime story is a beautiful meditation on feeling safe and drifting into a peaceful sleep.

cuentos.t: The Secret Dance of Naira the Little Bear
cuentos.r: Meet Naira, a big, strong bear with a beautiful dream: to dance ballet! This tender bedtime story celebrates body positivity, perseverance, and dancing to your own rhythm. Perfect for sweet dreams.
A clown tries too hard to be perfect... until a little girl helps him discover that his true magic lies in being his delightfully clumsy self. A heartwarming tale about embracing our imperfections!

An unexpected conversation on a quiet cliffside changes how thirteen-year-old Elena sees her future. This tender story helps teens navigate the pressure of growing up, showing that it's okay not to have all the answers yet.

Discover a delicate and magical tale where a lake fairy finds human love. A beautifully melancholic story about imagination, sacrifice, and the gentle bonding of two different worlds, perfect for sparking deep conversations.

cuentos.t: The Frost King, or The Power of Love
cuentos.r: When the cold-hearted Frost King declares war on the flowers, a brave fairy named Star sets out on a daring mission. Armed only with seeds and love, she proves kindness can melt the iciest of hearts.

Grandpa Elias's tall tales of racing trains and giant shopkeepers turn out to be profound life lessons hidden in everyday objects. A heartwarming bedtime story about the magic of being present, listening, and leaving a little goodness wherever we go.

cuentos.t: Teo the Mouse and the Giant Leaf
cuentos.r: Two little mice join forces to tame a giant, unruly leaf and build the coziest shelter from the rain.

cuentos.t: Three Little Paws on the Fence
cuentos.r: When a cold metal fence suddenly blocks their shared tunnel, a fox and an otter must invent a new way to say hello. A tender bedtime story celebrating friendship, resilience, and shared rituals.

Swept away from her bustling city alley by a fierce autumn wind, a tiny fly named Beatrix lands in a strange country barn. This comforting bedtime story teaches kids about embracing change, facing fears, and finding a true sense of belonging.

cuentos.t: Crugo and the Attack of the Lice
cuentos.r: Crugo hates taking baths... until some tiny, itchy visitors crash the party and completely change his day! A fun, prehistoric tale about hygiene.

cuentos.t: Professor Newton Nebula and the Cosmic Meatball
cuentos.r: A giant twenty-foot-tall girl, a massive pug, and a monstrous mosquito unleash absolute chaos on their neighborhood in this hilarious sci-fi adventure!
Every morning, a young girl leaves crumbs on her windowsill for a nervous sparrow. A tender story about friendship, trust, and the importance of never taking the ones we love for granted.

cuentos.t: Marcus, the Chameleon Who Dreamed in Color
cuentos.r: Marcus is tired of blending in! In this tender bedtime story, a brave chameleon leaves his camouflage behind to shine brightly with extraordinary new friends. A perfect tale celebrating imagination, self-expression, and the joy of being yourself.
A timid little duckling named Pip discovers that the water can be much more fun than he ever imagined in this sweet, rhyming bedtime story!

Eric the hedgehog thinks his prickly quills make him completely unhuggable, but his woodland friends refuse to give up! A tender, funny story about friendship, problem-solving, and the magic of connection.

cuentos.t: The Cave of the Blue Echoes
cuentos.r: When 11-year-old alien Lira hears rumors of a haunted cave, she packs her plasma flashlight and sets off to uncover the scientific truth behind the mysterious voices. A perfect tale of curiosity!

Dive into a thrilling underwater adventure! When a magical relic is stolen, two brave guardians must journey into the dark abyss to stop a war. A captivating tale about empathy, teamwork, and looking beyond prejudice.
Meet Titan, a tiny Chihuahua with a giant-sized spirit! When danger strikes the farm, this little pup proves that true bravery isn't measured by size, but by the size of your heart.

cuentos.t: The Grand Lost and Found Office
cuentos.r: When six-year-old Leo gets separated from his parents at the mall, he tumbles into a magical world: The Grand Lost and Found Office! This tender bedtime story transforms a universal childhood fear into a reassuring adventure, teaching kids a vital safety lesson.

A clever hare tries to cross the sea by tricking the fierce beasts that live within it. But when a prank goes wrong, who will step up to help? A classic Japanese myth about kindness, arrogance, and true leadership.
A curious dog discovers an old woman's biggest secret and changes several lives forever.
When a kindhearted young fisherman saves a mysterious turtle, he is swept away to the Eternal Land—a magical underwater kingdom where time stands still. A classic, bittersweet Japanese folktale.
A king's youngest son crosses the world to inherit an empire, and loses his name along the way.

cuentos.t: The Legend of Kintarō, the Golden Boy
cuentos.r: Raised in the mountains alongside his animal friends, the prodigious Kintarō walks toward a noble destiny.
A boy no taller than a thumb rows to the capital with a needle for a sword and a plan of his own.

cuentos.t: The Cherry Tomato Who Wanted to See the World
cuentos.r: A mischievous cherry tomato will do whatever it takes to escape and fulfill a very special dream.
A very anxious little mole learns to understand his fears with the help of those who love him.
An innocent little gray squirrel is accused of stealing nuts and ends up trapped inside a hollow tree.
Benjamin and his cousin Peter creep back into Mr. McGregor's garden to fetch Peter's lost clothes.

cuentos.t: The Story of a Fierce Bad Rabbit
cuentos.r: A fierce bad rabbit snatches a good little rabbit's carrot—but a hunter is not far away.

cuentos.t: The Tale of the Flopsy Bunnies
cuentos.r: The six little Flopsy Bunnies fall fast asleep beside the lettuces in Mr. McGregor's garden.

cuentos.t: The Tale of Ginger and Pickles
cuentos.r: Ginger the cat and Pickles the dog keep a shop where everyone buys—and nobody ever pays.
Mrs. Tittlemouse, the tidiest wood-mouse, battles a stream of most unexpected visitors.
When the boy king Buby loses his first tooth, he waits awake in his bedchamber for a visit from Ratón Pérez.
A teeny-tiny girl, born inside a flower, is carried out into the big world among toads, beetles, mice, and birds.
Pedrito, a chatty parrot who lives happily on a farm, flies far away one day and runs into a jaguar.
In a great, solitary river, many yacarés live peacefully until a human steamboat disturbs their waters.
A bee who refuses to work is kicked out of the hive on a cold night and learns what her duty is.
When a mysterious cat arrives at his farm, Mosi embarks on a journey among the stars that will change his destiny forever.
With the help of a friendly pigeon, a little chick searches the farm to find his daddy among the different birds.
The legendary city of Troy faces the greatest challenge in its history in a war where courage and cleverness will change everyone's destiny.
A miser sells everything he owns, buries his gold ingot, and goes every morning to look at it without ever spending it.
A woman goes out to hire a herdsman, and the bear, the wolf, and the fox must call the flock to show what they can do.

cuentos.t: The Illusionist Who Made Real Magic
cuentos.r: An illusionist discovers that his tricks are starting to come true, and his life takes a turn that is as chaotic as it is hilarious.
